S1214.reason: VCLT Article 7 presumes that heads of state, heads of government and foreign ministers may conclude treaties, and heads of mission may adopt treaty texts, without full powers in every case.

S0587.reason: Universal jurisdiction allows every State to prosecute a defined set of grave crimes irrespective of territory or nationality, not every international crime.

S1059.reason: In inter-State arbitration the parties appoint the tribunal; universal third-party appointment or a closed list is not the general rule (A and B are identical).
